title: Up and Back
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：up　|　正文 307 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 up 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Up, in 1961 the porter carried the bag at the cove, and everybody in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the porter had carried the bag ② up at once, and nobody had asked a single question. The porter had come to the coast two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the coast he had left behind him.

The journal for August 1955 puts it plainer. The bag was ③ up, and the visitor who kept it wrote of the bag ④ up in the same line; nothing in the coast was ever left up for long in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ up, and ⑥ Up came the visitor who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the coast had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the bag be bought ⑦ up at the cove, and that everybody be ⑧ up before the August rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried up.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971 she carried the bag ⑨ up in the rain when nobody else would, and ⑩ Up, she said in 1973, that was the part the coast never forgot; the journal still speaks of it up. She kept the bag in the same cove for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the coast never forgot how up it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 向上（句末状语，置于宾语之后：carried the bag up，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 向上（作表语，说明处所或去向：the bag was up）
C. adv. 在上面（置于句首：Up, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 在上面（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the bag up）
E. adv. 在上面（作介词宾语：from up）
F. adv. 在上面（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Up came the visitor）
G. adv. 向上（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be bought up at the cove）
H. adv. 向上（be up 说明所在或去向：everybody be up before the rains）

answers.why: up 意为“在上面”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Up, in 1961 …。
up 意为“向上”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had carried the bag up。
up 意为“向上”，此处作表语说明那件小小的行囊的去向或所在：was up。
up 意为“在上面”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the bag up。
up 意为“在上面”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from up。
up 意为“在上面”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Up came the visitor。
up 意为“向上”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be bought up at the cove。
up 意为“向上”，be up 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
up 意为“向上”，1971 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次搬上那件小小的行囊，副词置于句末。
up 意为“在上面”，母亲 1973 年那句话以地点状语开头：Up, …。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，挑夫在小湾搬上那件小小的行囊；海岸里人人都说那是头一回。（Up, …）
挑夫已经把那件小小的行囊搬上向上。（… up …）
那件小小的行囊当时就在向上。（was up）
行记那一行写的是向上的那件小小的行囊。（the bag up）
叔叔是从向上回来的。（from up）
记录要求那件小小的行囊在小湾被买向上。（be bought up）
